method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town09_shapes.py) -> Codex-style soft studio concept render of a throwaway blockout by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_render09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town, single game asset: 食肆客棧 (TownInn). Design: Two-storey 12 x 9 m inn: red lacquered columns, open lattice front, dining hall with five tables, counter and wine shelf, straight stair, three upstairs guest rooms with beds, front balcony, blank signboard, two red lanterns, tiled gable roof and a rear kitchen annex with stove, woks and chimney. Scale: Approx. 13.8 x 13 x 9.6 m; floor-to-floor 3.4 m; stair 17 risers of 0.2 m. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (dark cedar timber, blue-grey stone, charcoal tile roofs, restrained jade and ochre accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, orthographic, entire object visible on a neutral warm paper background. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
